prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Chengdu for a couple days, just wandering around and eating my way through the city.
Earlier in 2025 my coworker kept talking about that Beijing to Shanghai hop they took for work, like it was the most routine thing ever.
They said the ticket ended up being on Air China, flight CA1234, and it was for 2025-03-15.
Oh, and the passenger name on that booking was Olivia Brown — HR had put it through, so she didn’t even touch it.
Back in Chengdu, my friend had already arranged parking at Chunxi Road IFS Parking starting 2025-03-25 15:00 for 24 hours; the plate was 川D78901 and the contact number on it was 13892862812.
